world.title: Vineet Bhatia pushes ahead with new dining concept in Dubai
world.description: Vineet Bhatia, the first chef of Indian origin to receive a Michelin star, opened a new restaurant in Dubai last week. But with the UAE still on alert for occasional drone and missile attacks, and Dubai reeling from a drop in visitors, the timing may seem strange.
